name: Gyakujoku Hiai ~Mistress~
source:
Main heroine is SM club queen. After one her session she learns that she has become №2 of the club. She decides to become №1 by to expelling her rival...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是SM俱乐部的女王。结束一次调教后，她得知自己的地位已经跌至俱乐部第二名。为了重回第一，她决定赶走竞争对手…
